sourceTitle: The Pennyles Pilgrimage Or The Money-lesse Perambulation of John Taylor
description: "The Pennyles Pilgrimage" by John Taylor is a narrative travelogue written in the early 17th century. The book chronicles the author's adventurous journey on foot from London to Edinburgh, undertaken without any money and without relying on charity or assistance.
